messages:
Maya Patel: quick sync — where are we on the console observability sprint? short status pls, esp dashboards + trace hooks + error analysis view.
Jon Rivera: dashboards: basic widgets are in staging, waiting on final query from infra for the new sample_rate metric. most panels render. :thumbsup:
Ali Chen: trace hooks: my PR is blocked by the agent auth change (eng-infra). raised a dependency ticket earlier today. PR: https://git.company/ri/trace-hooks/pull/142
Sasha Kim: error analysis view: UX skeleton done, need backend endpoint for grouped errors -> will depend on retention cutover. sending mockups in thread. :eyes:
Maya Patel: can we call out owners + rough ETA? trying to roll up for product.
Jon Rivera: owner for dashboards is me. ETA if infra query lands: 48–72h for final polish + prod canary. if infra delayed, we can ship without sample_rate and toggle later.
Ali Chen: owner for trace hooks is @Ali Chen. ETA optimistic 3 days after infra change merged. blocking note: KV token change in infra requires update to our agent init flow — I have a patch but it's gated.
Sasha Kim: owner for error view is @Sasha Kim + design. ETA depends on retention cutover; if retention cutover lands this week we can wire endpoints in 2 days, otherwise +1 sprint.
Maya Patel: ok — action items: 1) @Jon follow up w/eng-infra on sample_rate query (assign ticket) 2) @Ali keep PR patch ready, ping here when infra merge done 3) @Sasha attach mockups + acceptance criteria in the ticket. I'll update product with the rollup.
Jon Rivera: pinged infra — @eng-infra can you weigh in? (cc @infra-desk)
deploy-bot: CI for trace-hooks/pull/142 — tests: failed (timeout on integration tests). Logs: https://ci.company/2805/142/logs
Ali Chen: noted CI flake, rerunning now. if infra merge happens first the tests should pass.
Maya Patel: thanks all. i'll set a brief async check-in at EOD — paste status updates here. try to keep replies short.
Jon Rivera: will do.
Sasha Kim: adding mockups & AC in ticket now.
Ali Chen: rerun done, CI green locally; will re-run CI after infra merge.
Maya Patel: last ask — anyone who expects a slip, call it now so we can adjust canary window.
Jon Rivera: slight risk if infra query is delayed >72h. marking as 'at-risk' for product.
Sasha Kim: marking as 'maybe' — dependent on retention cutover timing.
Ali Chen: on me to unblock, will ping infra again in 30m.
